title: Sources: some potential Oura IPO investors decided to hold off, citing its ~$15B target valuation and poor post-listing performance of peers like Fitbit (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: some potential Oura IPO investors decided to hold off, citing its ~$15B target valuation and poor post-listing performance of peers like Fitbit — Some investors approached about potentially buying shares in Oura Inc.'s now-delayed initial public offering decided not to go forward …
